10 places you should stay
silent at all costs

1. Be silent when you're about
to promise something big.

2. Be silent when you're
being tested.

3. Be silent when a friend
needs to vent.

4. Be silent when gossip
starts.

5. Be silent when the bill comes.
Just pay your part.

6. Be silent when the driver
is lost and stressed.

7. Be silent when you're tired.

8. Be silent when the experts
are talking. Then go learn.
